title: Axolotl dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#ff9ecf'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#ffd6e7'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#ff9ecf'/>
  <!-- face lighter patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#ffd6e7'/>
  <!-- gills left -->
  <path d='M30 34 Q18 24 20 34 Q22 40 30 38 Z' fill='#ff6fae'/>
  <path d='M29 40 Q16 38 19 46 Q24 50 31 44 Z' fill='#ff6fae'/>
  <path d='M30 46 Q20 50 25 56 Q30 58 34 50 Z' fill='#ff6fae'/>
  <!-- gills right -->
  <path d='M70 34 Q82 24 80 34 Q78 40 70 38 Z' fill='#ff6fae'/>
  <path d='M71 40 Q84 38 81 46 Q76 50 69 44 Z' fill='#ff6fae'/>
  <path d='M70 46 Q80 50 75 56 Q70 58 66 50 Z' fill='#ff6fae'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='3.5' fill='#3a1f4f'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='39' r='3.5' fill='#3a1f4f'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 47 Q50 51 55 47' stroke='#3a1f4f' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='45' r='3' fill='#ff5f9e' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='45' r='3' fill='#ff5f9e' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- left arm up dancing -->
  <path d='M32 58 Q20 52 16 42' stroke='#ff9ecf' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='42' r='4' fill='#ffd6e7'/>
  <!-- right arm out dancing -->
  <path d='M68 58 Q82 56 86 48' stroke='#ff9ecf' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='48' r='4' fill='#ffd6e7'/>
  <!-- left leg kicking -->
  <path d='M42 78 Q34 86 28 84' stroke='#ff9ecf' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='84' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ffd6e7'/>
  <!-- right leg down -->
  <path d='M58 78 Q62 88 68 88' stroke='#ff9ecf' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='88' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ffd6e7'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M68 70 Q82 70 84 62 Q80 66 74 64 Z' fill='#ff6fae'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <path d='M20 24 L20 16 L28 14 L28 22' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
    <ellipse cx='19' cy='24' rx='3' ry='2'/>
    <ellipse cx='27' cy='22' rx='3' ry='2'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#7fe0ff'>
    <path d='M78 16 L78 8 L86 6 L86 14' stroke='#7fe0ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
    <ellipse cx='77' cy='16' rx='3' ry='2'/>
    <ellipse cx='85' cy='14' rx='3' ry='2'/>
  </g>
</svg>
